title: SalesForge AI — Intelligent Sales Training Platform
summary: An AI-driven sales training platform that runs AI roleplay simulations, MCQ assessments, and conversion/risk prediction models for sales teams using local LLMs and various ML classifiers. A utility script (generate_lead_data.py) uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to train on and synthesize lead data for the platform's training pipeline.
